description.fun: Totodile bites everything, its Trainer included, and its little jaws are strong enough to crush what they catch, so turning your back on one is a bad idea. Its name is simply 'tot' plus crocodile, and its Japanese name, Waninoko, means 'child of a crocodile'. Like real crocodiles, its family sleeps with one eye open, resting half its brain at a time.
description.guide: A small, crocodile-like Water-type Pokémon and one of Johto's first partners, also a first partner in Lumiose City in Legends: Z-A. It is playful but rough, with a habit of biting anything in sight using jaws strong enough to injure. It evolves into Croconaw and then Feraligatr.
description.tagline: A playful little crocodile that bites first and asks later

description.fun: Croconaw is said to have 48 fangs, slanted backwards like fishhooks so they can't be pulled out once they sink in. Once it bites it won't let go until its teeth come out, and they quickly grow back. Its look adds a caveman touch, with a spiky crest like a mohawk and a chest pattern like an animal-skin tunic.
description.guide: The middle stage of the Totodile line, a Water-type crocodilian Pokémon. Its backward-slanting fangs work like fishhooks, so it does not let go once it bites, and lost teeth soon grow back. It evolves into Feraligatr.
description.tagline: Forty-eight hooked fangs and no intention of letting go

description.fun: Feraligatr opens its huge jaws to scare off foes, and once it clamps down it shakes its head to tear free. Too heavy to carry itself easily on land, it often drops to all fours, but powerful hind legs make it fast when it hunts. Its odd spelling probably comes from Gold and Silver's ten-letter limit on names. Its Mega Evolution grows a fin shaped like a Totodile's head.
description.guide: The final form of Totodile, a large Water-type crocodilian Pokémon with powerful jaws. It struggles to carry its weight on land but moves fast when hunting. In Legends: Z-A it can Mega Evolve into Mega Feraligatr.
description.tagline: Big-jawed Johto gator that lost an 'o' to fit its name

description.fun: Its dorsal fin swells into a red hood shaped like a Totodile's head. Lowering the hood and clasping its hands makes a false jaw that bites ten times harder than its real one, and it turns Water and Dragon.
